quote: We had such a great experience using Lisa for my daughter's senior pictures! She was good at communication prior to our photo shoot and then when we arrived was very prepared with sites already scouted and a time frame mapped out which allowed for several different locations and time to change in between. She helped with wardrobe questions and was amazing with knowing just how to get the natural, beautiful pictures we were going for! You can tell she definitely has lots of experience! My daughter is super happy with her photos and our only difficulty in the whole experience is choosing which photos to purchase and use as there were so many great ones!
